ticket.title: CSV export contains only the header row when the invoice list is filtered by Overdue status
ticket.description: When the invoice list is filtered by status Overdue, which shows twelve invoices, clicking Export CSV downloads a file containing only the header row. Exporting without the filter works fine.

stepsToReproduce: Filter by status Overdue, which shows twelve invoices
bug.actualResult: The file downloads but contains only the header row, with no invoices.
bug.expectedResult: A file containing the twelve overdue invoices.
